animation_metaphor: Interface Layer → Control Layer → Capability Layer → Execution Layer
data_flow: Interface Layer → Control Layer → Capability Layer → Execution Layer → State Layer
input_types: environment variables: AGENTOS_HOME, CHROME_EXECUTABLE, GROKBOT_OFFICE_DIR, PATH, XAI_API_KEY, XAI_BASE_URL
known_limitations: CURRENT_STATE.md: Heuristic operation resolution without explicit operation (safe default).
CURRENT_STATE.md: Quality evaluator is heuristic (no model judge wired; evaluator slot exists).
CURRENT_STATE.md: Backoff computed, not slept. API has no auth — bind loopback, trusted networks only.
CURRENT_STATE.md: No live model calls were made during verification (cost/latency unmeasured).
CURRENT_STATE.md: Learned routing returns no executor when no measured candidate profile exists; the hard-gated router remains authoritative rather than inventing a score.
CURRENT_STATE.md: Single-token hints use word boundaries (`compute` no longer matches `computer`).
major_components: models.py — Dataclasses + enums: Objective, Capability, Execution, Event, VerificationResult, Failure, Evidence, Report, Strategy, Role, PlanStep, ExecutionPla...
store.py — sqlite persistence, schema, row↔model translation, per-thread connections. Survives restarts.
policies.py — `ExecutionPolicy`: blocked patterns, destructive gating, approvals, write roots, secret redaction.
registry.py — Native+detected catalog (9), `register`/`remove`, `discover`, honest `probe`, deterministic `select`, configured-CLI registration. Holds adapter in...
router.py — `Router.plan`: 9 strategies, capability scoring (health+history+cost/latency), rationale, roles, conflict detection.
adapters/base.py — `Adapter` protocol, `ExecutionRequest`, `AdapterResult`. The seam future providers implement.
adapters/proc.py — Shared subprocess runner + binary resolution for CLI-backed adapters.
adapters/shell.py — Policy-gated subprocess: command/argv, cwd, env (scrubbed), timeout-kill, duration.
adapters/filesystem.py — Real file ops: `fs.read/write/exists/list`; writes policy-gated.
adapters/echo.py — Echo op for tests/demos. No external effects.
primary_user: A universal, provider-neutral AI Agent Engine and orchestration control plane.
primary_visual_metaphor: nodes converging on a coordinating cell
primary_workflow: Verified useful output is the goal. Lower cost is a result of choosing the smallest capable path, not a reason to fabricate measurements or skip verification.
problem: AgentOS is the generic execution and orchestration engine. It accepts an objective, inspects the current state, discovers capabilities, plans a bounded route, executes through an adapter, verifies the result, persists evidence, and decides what to do next.
